newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was at near standstill in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 100 head slaughter steers and 200 head heifers; 20,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,700 formulated and 43 loads or 1,500 head of CME delivery cattle.
Steers - pen select and choice 2-3 1200 lbs North Plains 69.00.
Heifers - few select and choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs north plains 69.00.
Wk to Date: 20,500 Week Ago: 141,600 Year Ago: 17,800
